visual_elements.description: Grid of 6 scatter plot panels. Bottom-center 'Flame.txt': blue points forming a downward curve/flame base on left and right, red cluster at top-center. Bottom-right 'Jain.txt': blue cluster upper-left, red points forming a C-shaped curve on right.

recreation_brief:
1. Create a 16:9 slide with light gray background (#D9D9D9).
2. Add a thick black rectangle across the bottom edge as a footer.
3. Center the title 'Check class of each background point' on line 1 and 'in the following datasets' on line 2, bold, red (#C00000), near top.
4. Place a yellow circle with black outline at top-right containing '40'.
5. Create six panels in a 3x2 grid, evenly spaced below the title.
6. For each panel: place a light blue rounded rectangle label above with dark blue text: top row 'Aggregation.txt', 'Compound.txt', 'Spiral.txt'; bottom row 'Pathbased.txt', 'Flame.txt', 'Jain.txt'.
7. Below each label draw a red-bordered white square containing a scatter plot approximating the described cluster shapes and colors.
8. Use colors blue (#0000FF), red (#FF0000), green (#00FF00), magenta (#FF00FF), yellow (#FFFF00), cyan (#00FFFF), black (#000000) for points.
9. Ensure no extra text or elements; match spacing and alignment as seen.
